purpose: Create the missing current-f01e TP2/MTP0/eager/F16 target-only curve and same-topology TP2 oracle set at exact 2K, 4K, 8K, 16K, 24K, and 32K. Cross-topology equality is comparison evidence, never a prerequisite for freezing a quality-clean TP2-native receipt.

prior_evidence.current_image_gap: No current-f01e AutoRound TP2/MTP0/eager/F16 exact-depth sentinel or curve exists.

older_tp2_evidence.identity_difference: Older b2dd9ce73d source, graph FULL_AND_PIECEWISE, gpu-memory-utilization 0.9, and different cache/runtime contract. It is historical coverage only, not a parent or target oracle.

current_cross_topology_controls.policy: Both are immutable comparison inputs. A mismatch is an explicit caveat and does not reject an otherwise objective-quality-clean TP2-native oracle.

exact_depth_contract.depth_zero_reason: The exact fixture has no empty active-context case; a short ordinary prompt would not measure context zero.
exact_depth_contract.comparison_policy: Record exact token equality and first divergence for every depth. TP1 mismatch is a cross-topology caveat, not a TP2-native freeze rejection.

quality_contract.objective_gate: pass_all plus exactly seven exact, eight repeat, and one long-context usage records, all with cached_tokens == 0
quality_contract.baseline_mismatch_policy: The current-image TP4 quality baseline is a cross-topology comparison caveat, not a TP2-native freeze rejection.

terminal_classification.passed-quality-clean-depth-expansion: All six exact TP2 depths, objective quality, TP2 topology, cache isolation, cleanup, and both comparison batteries pass; freeze all six TP2-native outputs.
terminal_classification.passed-quality-clean-depth-expansion-wit: All TP2-native gates pass but one or more TP1 token or TP4 quality comparisons differ; freeze all six TP2-native outputs with explicit caveats.
terminal_classification.partial-depth-expansion: One or more exact-depth requests fail. If objective quality and all global gates pass, preserve and freeze only exact-passing TP2-native depths; never infer missing depths.
terminal_classification.quarantined-objective-quality-failed: Exact depths may pass, but objective quality or any cache-zero record fails; preserve evidence and freeze no TP2 oracle.
terminal_classification.failed: Infrastructure, identity, topology, cache, or cleanup fails; retain evidence and freeze no TP2 oracle.
